messages:
maria: Heads-up — change window for the upcoming infra + runtime release is tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. Freeze starts 00:00 UTC. Need sign-offs from infra, qa, security, and docs before we go. Anyone have blocking items?

siddharth: @maria can we confirm model pinning? we should pin inference runtime + model variant for the rollout. I suggest pin to service-runtime v1.12.4 and model bundle redwood-llm-v1.3.2-quant.

alex: infra ack — reserving dedicated GPU pool for the window (3 nodes in us-west-2). I'll set an autoscale override: min=3, max=6. Will also pin instance AMI to ami-0b12abcd for consistency.

jessica: qa here — staging smoke + perf passed on latest artifact. Test run summary: https://internal.ci/runs/4456 (smoke green, perf p95 within 10% of baseline). I'll run a quick regression suite during canary.

tara: security review complete. No new open ingress, S3/KMS access already scoped. Docs for audit included in the release PR. OK from sec side unless someone adds new network changes.

maria: Great. Quick checklist I'm pasting here for transparency:
- freeze starts 00:00 UTC (no non-hotfix merges)
- canary starts 02:15 UTC (10% traffic)
- smoke & perf gating at canary + 15m observation
- full rollout at 02:45 UTC if canary healthy
- rollback plan pinned and tested
- release notes + customer-facing changelog updated
Links: release PR https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/402, notes https://internal.docs/releases/402

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created by @maria — canary target: service/api-inference:v1.12.4, model: redwood-llm-v1.3.2-quant, canary region: us-west-2, canary weight: 10% at 02:15 UTC.

siddharth: Rollback commands (for quick copy):
```
# rollback to previous runtime and model
kubectl set image deployment/inference-service inference=service/api-inference:v1.12.3
kubectl annotate deployment/inference-service redwood/model-pin="redwood-llm-v1.3.1-legacy"
# verify pods restarted and smoke passed
```
If we detect quality regression we revert model to v1.3.1-legacy and pin for the route.

alex: I'll keep a spare node pool ready and enable realtime capacity alerts. Also setting longer grace period on LB so canary drains cleanly.

jessica: I'll run the post-canary smoke + latency suite and post results here. If anything >15% regression on gen quality or >2x error increase, we abort.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall shift @alex will be paged on anomalies for the next 6 hours starting 01:45 UTC.

tara: Adding an extra check: ensure KMS key rotation flag is off during release window (we confirmed).

maria: Locking the freeze now — no merges except approved hotfixes. Please add any last-minute blockers in this thread. :lock:

siddharth: :thumbsup: leaving notes in the release PR about pinned deps and rollback steps. Also tagging model evaluation artifact so QA can re-run locally if needed.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (1760001240). Canary rollout to 10% in us-west-2 initiated.

jessica: Canary smoke started. Running sample prompt set A/B.

deploy-bot: Canary complete (1760001280). All health checks OK. Observability: p95 latency 128ms (baseline 120ms), error rate +0.3%.

alex: Monitoring infra metrics — CPU/GPU within expected, network good. Cost burn within forecast.

jessica: Perf check: latency small uptick but quality A/B shows no regression on eval set. Marking canary OK.

maria: Proceeding with full rollout at 02:45 UTC. Reminder: follow rollback steps immediately if we see user-visible regression.

deploy-bot: Full rollout scheduled and in progress. Rollback endpoint: https://internal/ops/rollback/1760001234 — use the documented commands above.

oncall-bot: If any page is fired, oncall will escalate to @alex -> @siddharth -> @maria.

maria: Thanks everyone — post-release, please add any anomalies to the release PR and file a short blameless follow-up if we had to rollback.

jessica: Post-rollout quick checks done, no customer impact observed. Will leave final sign-off in the PR.

alex: All good from infra. Reverting autoscale override to normal after 1 hour.

maria: Final sign-off: release completed, notes published. Great job team :tada:
